name: Pumpkin seed oil

lead: Pumpkin seed oil is a dark green oil pressed from the seeds of Cucurbita pepo, traditional in Central European cooking and now sold as an oral supplement. It is promoted for prostate health and for slowing male pattern hair loss.

The main human evidence is a small randomised, placebo-controlled trial in men with androgenetic alopecia that reported higher hair counts after 24 weeks. A larger body of replication is missing, and evidence is considered preliminary.

paras: The oil is rich in unsaturated fatty acids, phytosterols and tocopherols. Laboratory work suggests phytosterols may weakly inhibit 5-alpha-reductase and have antioxidant effects, but the mechanism in humans is unproven.

It is typically well tolerated, with occasional gastrointestinal upset or allergic reactions in people allergic to seeds. Because it is sold as a food or supplement, product quality varies. It should not replace proven treatments for progressive hair loss.
